//next-sharp: The next pin below is 16.2.11, the security floor that clears all nine Next
advisories (every one reports its fixed range as >=16.0.0 <16.2.11).
It does NOT clear GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj in sharp, and no 16.2.x release can.
The arithmetic: every 16.2.x declares sharp ^0.34.5, whose ceiling is <0.35.0,
and the fix is 0.35.0 exactly. next@16.3.3 declares sharp ^0.35.3, so clearing
it means moving off the 16.2 line, which is a separate decision.
Whether it matters at all is UNSETTLED: the frontend deploys on Vercel, which
supplies its own image optimisation, so the bundled sharp may never run in
production. Nobody has checked which one Vercel uses. Settle that before
treating the advisory as either urgent or irrelevant. Recorded 2026-08-27.
